[7:16PM] #PWD #TrafficUpdate

Movement from Bolade-Oshodi through Shogunle, Ladipo, and enroute PWD is also smooth.
Traffic is slightly heavy at the Airport turning toward National, while the Ikeja Flyover remains calm.
From Ikeja Overpass to Ajayi Farm, traffic is light. Movement from Ile Zik through Mongoro, Cement, and toward Dopemu under the bridge is good, though approaching Dopemu Bridge is busy due to high influx. 
The return journey from Dopemu underpass back to Bolade Junction is smooth, with no major concerns.
Traffic officers are actively on ground ensuring effective control.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
Traffic Advisory – Chebucto Road - Connaught Avenue – Water System Upgrades

Beginning on Tuesday, August 5th until Thursday, August 7th, Dexter Construction on behalf of Halifax Water will complete an upgrade to the water transmission main along Chebucto Road and Newton Avenue. This upgrade will be completed during the night. 

Typical nighttime work hours will be 6:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
During this nightwork portion of the project, the following traffic control will be in place:
· Alternating lane closures on Chebucto Road
· Alternating lane closures inbound on Connaught Avenue between Berlin Street and Chebucto Road.
· Sidewalks in the work zone will be closed. Pedestrian traffic will be diverted to the opposite side of the street.

Please note work will continue during the day to complete reinstatement work. 

https://t.co/UT3CTtbw3Q
